description: This file defines an interface for analytics backend components within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It declares the IAnalyticsBackend interface with methods for configuration and event sending, as well as an Event structure encapsulating event details.

classes.name: IAnalyticsBackend
classes.description: Interface for analytics backend implementations, providing methods for configuration and event transmission, and a nested Event structure for event data.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the analytics backend.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the analytics backend with the provided shell, system time, and local store.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Sends an analytics event to the backend.
